list_blurb: Site survey, load assessment and certified installation of home and workplace chargers, with the electrical work signed off properly.
hero_description: A home charger is the cheapest and gentlest way to charge an electric car, but only if the supply behind it can carry the load. We survey the property, assess the electrical panel, and install a charger that is matched to what the building can actually deliver in {{city}}.
meta_title: EV Charger Installation in {{city}} | EVS {{country}}
meta_description: Home and business EV charger installation in {{city}}: site survey, electrical load assessment and certified fitting, tested under real load.
meta_keywords: EV charger installation {{city}}, home EV charger {{country}}, electric car charger fitting {{city}}, workplace EV charging, EV charging point installation {{city}}

faqs.answer: That is what the site survey is for. We measure the existing load and available capacity, and if the panel is marginal we will tell you before anything is ordered — usually there is a load-managing charger or a smaller unit that solves it without an upgrade.
faqs.question: How do I know if my electrical panel can take a charger?

faqs.answer: Sometimes, with building management's agreement and depending on where the supply and the parking bay are. We survey first and tell you honestly whether it is practical.
faqs.question: Can a charger be installed in an apartment building?

faqs.answer: Most homes support 7.4 kW, which fully charges a typical EV overnight. Higher rates need three-phase supply, which we check during the survey.
faqs.question: How fast will a home charger be?

hero_title: EV Charger Installation for Homes and Businesses
about_description: Most charging problems start at the wall rather than the car. A panel already close to capacity, undersized cable, or a circuit shared with heavy household loads will all limit charging speed or trip out under load — and none of that is visible until the charger is fitted. We start with a survey: what the supply can carry, where the car parks, and what the cable run has to cross. From there we recommend a charger rated for the property rather than the maximum the car could theoretically accept, install it to standard, and test it under real load before we leave.

benefits.title: Lower running cost
benefits.description: Charging at home on a residential tariff costs a fraction of public fast charging, and the saving compounds over every year of ownership.

benefits.title: Gentler on the battery
benefits.description: Slow AC charging generates far less heat than DC fast charging, which is the single biggest factor in how well a pack ages.

benefits.title: Ready every morning
benefits.description: The car charges while you sleep. No detours, no apps, no queues, and no planning around station availability.

benefits.title: Installed to the building's real capacity
benefits.description: A load assessment first means the charger works at its rated speed instead of tripping out or forcing you to run other appliances around it.

about_description: معظم مشاكل الشحن تبدأ من الجدار لا من السيارة. لوحة كهربائية قاربت طاقتها، أو كابل أصغر من اللازم، أو دائرة مشتركة مع أحمال منزلية ثقيلة — كلها تحدّ من سرعة الشحن أو تفصل تحت الحمل، ولا يظهر أي منها قبل تركيب الشاحن. نبدأ بالمعاينة: ما يتحمّله التمديد، وأين تقف السيارة، وما الذي يمرّ عليه مسار الكابل. ثم نوصي بشاحن مناسب للعقار لا بأقصى ما تقبله السيارة نظرياً، ونركّبه وفق المعايير، ونختبره تحت حمل حقيقي قبل أن نغادر.

faqs.answer: Fault code reading, software and module updates, 12-volt battery testing and replacement, charging system checks and routine inspections. Anything needing a lift or high-voltage battery work has to come to the workshop.
faqs.question: What can actually be done on-site?

faqs.answer: Yes, and it is one of the most common calls. A dead EV is usually a 12-volt failure, which is diagnosable and often fixable where the car sits.
faqs.question: My EV is completely dead. Can you come to it?

faqs.answer: Not necessarily, and it is frequently cheaper once you account for recovery. We quote before attending so you can decide.
faqs.question: Is mobile service more expensive than the workshop?

hero_title: Mobile EV Service and On-Site Diagnostics
about_description: An electric car that will not wake up is the most common call we get, and it is very often a 12-volt battery or a charging fault rather than anything that needs a workshop. Sending a technician to the car resolves a good share of those on the spot. What mobile service is not is a substitute for a proper facility: high-voltage battery work, anything requiring a lift, and body or paint work all have to come in, and we will say so plainly rather than making two visits out of one job. The point is to save you a recovery truck when the fault does not warrant one.

benefits.title: No recovery needed for minor faults
benefits.description: A flat 12-volt battery or a charging fault that stops the car can usually be diagnosed and resolved where it stands.

benefits.title: Diagnosis before you commit
benefits.description: Knowing what is actually wrong before the car moves means you are not paying to transport a car for a job that takes twenty minutes.

benefits.title: Service around your day
benefits.description: Routine checks and software work happen at your home or workplace instead of costing you a trip and a wait.

benefits.title: An honest answer about the workshop

faqs.answer: نعم، وهو من أكثر الاتصالات شيوعاً. السيارة المتوقفة كلياً سببها غالباً عطل في 12 فولت، وهو قابل للتشخيص وغالباً للإصلاح في مكانه.

hero_title: الخدمة المتنقلة والتشخيص في الموقع
about_description: السيارة الكهربائية التي لا تستيقظ هي أكثر اتصال يصلنا، والسبب غالباً بطارية 12 فولت أو عطل شحن لا شيء يستدعي ورشة. إرسال فني إلى السيارة يحلّ جزءاً كبيراً منها في الموقع. لكن الخدمة المتنقلة ليست بديلاً عن منشأة كاملة: أعمال بطاريات الجهد العالي، وكل ما يحتاج رافعة، وأعمال الهيكل والدهان يجب أن تأتي إلينا، وسنقول ذلك بوضوح بدل أن نحوّل عملاً واحداً إلى زيارتين. الهدف أن نوفّر عليك سطحة حين لا يستحق العطل ذلك.
